messages:
mira: FYI sample-app CI is failing on embeddings.rerank.batch. Response shapes are inconsistent across runs — sometimes pure scores, sometimes dicts with metadata.

mira: Minimal async repro from the sample:```python
resp = await client.embeddings.rerank.batch(
    queries=["find me"],
    docs=[["docA", "docB"]]
)
# sometimes -> [[0.91, 0.06]]
# other times -> [[{"doc_id":"docA","score":0.91},{"doc_id":"docB","score":0.06}]]
```

owen: Which wheel/commit? Could be retry middleware re-parsing the body and skipping the normalizer.

mira: Wheel built from main this morning. Looks correlated with token refresh logs mid-request (we see a retry).

tess: I dug briefly into the client: rerank has a tiny normalizer on the sync path. Async path + batching wrapper might bypass it on some retry branches. Also type stubs still say List[List[float]] which is incorrect if we ever return dicts.

amanda: Quick mitigation: add a small helper in examples called rerank_normalize(rows) that turns [[{...}]] -> [[score,...]] so sample-apps can stay stable until SDK patch lands. Eg:```python
def rerank_normalize(rows):
    return [[(r.get("score") if isinstance(r, dict) else r) for r in row] for row in rows]
```

owen: Long-term fix: canonicalize at the public API boundary (sync+async) so all callers get normalized output unless they explicitly opt into metadata. Also add an include_metadata: bool = False flag to the method signature. Default False preserves backwards compat.

tess: Agreed. I'll make a PR that: (1) calls canonicalizer in embeddings.rerank.batch public entrypoints, (2) widens typing stubs to List[List[Union[float, Mapping[str, Any]]]] temporarily, (3) adds include_metadata flag with typed return for both branches, (4) unit tests for sync/async + retry path, (5) update examples to use rerank_normalize helper during rollout.

amanda: Add a small mypy test that fails if we regress the stub. Also add a CHANGELOG line under "Bugfix (python)" so support/customer-engineering can point customers to it.

owen: Can we keep the server contract as-is (server can return dicts) and make the client responsible for normalization? Safer for rollout.

tess: Yes. The client should be the compatibility layer. Also ensure the retry wrapper replays normalization after a retry.

amanda: I'll draft the example helper and update sample-app to call it. That unblocks onboarding tests immediately.

sdk-bot: Issue created: #3589 - "python: embeddings.rerank.batch inconsistent response shape under retry (async batching)". CI triggered, linked PR template.

mira: Please tag me on the PR. Once merged I'll re-run sample-app smoke and confirm onboarding flow is green.

owen: For the PR, include a small performance note: include_metadata=True will increase payload sizes; document in the API docstring.

tess: Noted. Also will add a migration note in the samples/README and a backport plan for 0.9.x.

amanda: Plan: quick examples helper + CI unblock today; canonicalizer + types + tests in the patch; follow-up to expose include_metadata formally after product sign-off.

mira: Thanks everyone — that should clear the onboarding friction for customers hitting this.
